orgName: British Champions Day (British Champions Series Ltd)

source.name: British Champions Day - QIPCO extends British Champions Day sponsorship to 2028
source.note: 'Qatar Holdings and Investment Company (QIPCO) has extended its sponsorship of Britain's richest raceday... until 2028. QIPCO has sponsored the race meeting since its inaugural running in 2011.'

note: Title sponsor 2011 to Jul 2026, still contracted to 2028; headline role passed to subsidiary Qatar Racing on 4 Aug 2026. Fee not published. Private royal-family company, not a state entity.
